name: Mnemo
description: Vector embedding watermarking and provenance infrastructure for AI pipelines
tagline: Prove ownership of AI embeddings. One API call. Any model. Any vector DB.

core_operations.name: embed
core_operations.description: Watermark a single embedding vector. Returns vector_uid and watermarked_vector. Optionally accepts raw `subject` context; the server derives a tenant-scoped subject_fingerprint and (when subject binding is enabled+configured server-side) returns a server-issued subject_proof carrier.
core_operations.note: `subject` is RAW client context only; the server derives all trust (fingerprint + proof). The client cannot supply subject_fingerprint/trust_mode/proof fields. `subject_proof` is absent unless a subject was supplied and the transport is enabled+configured.

core_operations.name: verify
core_operations.description: Verify watermark on a vector. Returns verified status, confidence score, and original vector_uid. Optionally accepts an opaque subject_proof carrier (server-verified).
core_operations.note: This is the primary billable operation. Charged per call above plan quota. `subject_proof` is an opaque, UNTRUSTED carrier replayed verbatim; the server re-verifies it. It is consulted only on a STRICT oracle-only Case 3 verify under FP-squash — not on every verify.

core_operations.name: health
core_operations.description: Service liveness check. No authentication required.

core_operations.name: usage
core_operations.description: Current period usage, quota, and overage. Safe for agents to poll frequently.

subject_binding.summary: Optional trusted subject binding. The server owns all trust; the SDK is transport only.
rules: subject is RAW client context; the server derives the tenant-scoped subject_fingerprint.
subject_proof is a server-issued, opaque, UNTRUSTED carrier; the SDK never validates or trusts it; the server re-verifies it (tenant-scoped, UID-bound HMAC).
STRICT is the provenance-grade / claim-bearing posture.
subject_proof is consulted only on a STRICT oracle-only Case 3 verify under FP-squash; it does not run on every verify and does not imply always-on latency.
BALANCED and HIGH_RECALL are non-claim-bearing for PQ / oracle-only subject-proof recovery.
missing or invalid proofs fail closed server-side.
subject_binding.batch: Not supported. There are no batch embed/verify endpoints or SDK methods; batch will only exist if/when the Mnemo core runtime defines an explicit metered batch contract.

pricing.philosophy: Embed cheap, charge on proof. The value is in verification, not ingestion.

ttl_hours.description: How long Mnemo retains key material for future verify() calls

usage_class.description: Governs data handling, audit retention, and billing classification

retention.description: Key material retention override. extended and permanent require Growth+

region.description: Data residency for watermark key material

sdk_symbols.private: All algorithm, key derivation, and detection logic is server-side only
